definition: Preoperative count and morphological severity of osseous fractures across anatomical sites. Categorized as non-displaced/simple, displaced non-comminuted, comminuted/segmental, or high-energy bone loss/defect.
required_inputs: fracture_locations (array of subsites), documented_severity (enum), bilateral_injury (boolean), panfacial_involvement (boolean)
source_grounding: Fonseca Ch. 12 (pp. 232-247; multi-buttress collapse, comminution); Mittermiller et al. 2019 (PAP-014; Level 2 location vs Level 3 displacement reliability).
scoring_proposal: Categorical profile: Mild (1 isolated non-displaced), Moderate (1-2 displaced non-comminuted), Severe (multiple comminuted or panfacial). Exact scalar weighting PENDING SURGEON VALIDATION.
clinical_rationale: Greater number of fracture lines and comminution exponentially increase the difficulty of anatomical re-approximation and stability.
uncertainty_and_limitations: Mittermiller et al. showed comminution/displacement variables have lower inter-rater agreement (kappa=0.59) than location (kappa=0.69).
double_counting_safeguard: Measures pre-injury skeletal disruption only; does not score how many bones were surgically opened (which is scored in Criterion 2).
verification_scope: full text (Fonseca Ch. 12) / full text (Mittermiller 2019 PMC6834479)

criterion_name: Number of Anatomical Regions and Bones Operated On
definition: Direct quantification of distinct anatomical craniofacial compartments and individual osseous units exposed and surgically addressed during the intervention.
required_inputs: anatomical_regions_operated (Upper Face, Orbit, Midface, Lower Face), bones_operated (Frontal, Nasal/Ethmoid, Zygoma, Maxilla, Palatine/Sphenoid, Mandible)
source_grounding: Fonseca Ch. 12 (pp. 232-235; multi-pillar load transfer); Perry & Holmes Atlas Ch. 19 (p. 805; panfacial skeletal repair sequencing).
scoring_proposal: Count of regions (1 to 4) and count of operated bones (1 to 6). Profile bands: Monostotic/Single-compartment vs Polystotic/Multi-compartment. PENDING SURGEON VALIDATION.
clinical_rationale: Multi-compartmental surgery requires separate repositioning vectors, continuous re-verification of occlusal/spatial relationships, and wider exposure.
uncertainty_and_limitations: Surgical documentation may state 'midface ORIF' without enumerating each separate bone.
double_counting_safeguard: Distinct from fracture location; records only what was actually operated on. A conservative fracture is excluded.
verification_scope: full text (Fonseca Ch. 12) / full text (Atlas Ch. 19)

definition: The technical difficulty of anatomical fragment re-approximation: closed traction/IMF only, simple direct anatomic reduction, multi-axial traction against displacement vectors, complex comminuted mosaic puzzle reassembly, or computer-assisted navigation/PSI.
source_grounding: Fonseca Ch. 12 (pp. 240-244; Le Fort disjunctions and buttress comminution); Bly et al. 2013 (PAP-005; computer-assisted navigation in complex multi-vector defects).
scoring_proposal: Ordinal complexity tier: Closed/Minimal (Level 1), Open Anatomic (Level 2), Multi-axial Difficult (Level 3), Comminuted Puzzle/Navigation (Level 4). PENDING SURGEON VALIDATION.
clinical_rationale: Severely displaced fragments with muscle distraction (e.g. masseter/pterygoid pull on angle/condyle or craniofacial telescoping) require high physical effort and precision reduction.
uncertainty_and_limitations: Operative notes often describe reduction qualitatively without standard grading.
double_counting_safeguard: Evaluates the reduction maneuver itself, not the number of plates applied (Criterion 5) or approach used (Criterion 7).

definition: The specific operative procedures executed during surgery: ORIF, internal orbital mesh reconstruction, patient-specific implant (PSI), autologous bone grafting, alloplastic grafting, frontal sinus cranialization/obliteration, medial/lateral canthopexy, tracheostomy.
source_grounding: Perry & Holmes Atlas Ch. 19 (pp. 808-811; orbital reconstruction and secondary revision); Whitehouse 1994 (PAP-003; orbital volume expansion); Zhang 2012 (PAP-004; posterior ledge defect).
scoring_proposal: Multi-procedure inventory profile. High-complexity flags for cranialization, autologous donor site harvest, and posterior orbital wall repair. PENDING SURGEON VALIDATION.
clinical_rationale: Procedures involving skull base, orbital apex, or autologous tissue harvesting add distinct surgical phases, anatomical risk, and technical demands.
uncertainty_and_limitations: Operative reports may lump multiple steps into 'ORIF of facial fractures'.
double_counting_safeguard: Captures the nature of the interventions; hardware counts used within these procedures are recorded in Criterion 5.
verification_scope: full text (Atlas Ch. 19) / full text (Whitehouse 1994 PMC504888)

definition: Quantitative count and structural specification of osteosynthesis hardware installed: plates, screws, orbital meshes, reconstruction plates (2.4/2.7 mm load-bearing), and custom PSIs, with documented anatomical fixation sites.
required_inputs: hardware_documented (boolean), plate_count (int), screw_count (int), mesh_implant_count (int), reconstruction_plate_used (boolean), custom_patient_specific_implant_used (boolean), fixation_sites (array)
source_grounding: Kroon et al. 1991 (PAP-009; biomechanical load sharing vs bearing); Nagase et al. 2005 (PAP-010; multi-site plate placement); Mosbah 2003 (PAP-011).
scoring_proposal: Hardware burden profile: Low (<2 plates, <8 screws), Moderate (2-4 plates, 8-16 screws), High (>4 plates, >16 screws, or heavy load-bearing reconstruction bar). PENDING SURGEON VALIDATION.
clinical_rationale: Heavy load-bearing reconstruction plates (mandibular continuity defects) and multi-plate buttress fixation indicate high biomechanical instability and surgical labor.
uncertainty_and_limitations: Implant logs may be missing or unitemized in retrospective records. Missing hardware logs must NOT be assumed zero.
double_counting_safeguard: Quantifies mechanical implants placed, independent of the surgical approach used to place them (Criterion 7).

definition: Extent of concomitant soft-tissue destruction (degloving, avulsion, complex lacerations), specialized anatomical structures repaired (facial nerve branches, parotid duct, lacrimal system, medial canthus), and systemic trauma (C-spine, TBI, vascular).
required_inputs: extensive_facial_lacerations_or_degloving (bool), primary_nerve_repair_or_decompression (bool), lacrimal_system_repair_or_intubation (bool), concomitant_cervical_spine_injury (bool), concomitant_traumatic_brain_injury (bool), concomitant_vascular_injury (bool)
source_grounding: Fonseca Ch. 12 (pp. 234-237; C-spine Denis 3-column instability, CTA head/neck vascular trauma); Perry & Holmes Atlas Ch. 19 (pp. 805, 815; soft tissue handling).
scoring_proposal: Categorical co-injury profile: Isolated skeletal vs Skeletal + Complex soft tissue/neurovascular/cervical spine involvement. PENDING SURGEON VALIDATION.
clinical_rationale: Operating in the presence of unstable cervical spine requires rigid in-line stabilization, avoiding neck extension, and carefully coordinating with neurosurgery/trauma teams.
uncertainty_and_limitations: Associated injuries may be documented in trauma registry rather than operative maxillofacial note.
double_counting_safeguard: Measures non-osseous and systemic surgical modifiers, strictly separate from skeletal fracture count (Criterion 1).
verification_scope: full text (Fonseca Ch. 12) / full text (Atlas Ch. 19)

definition: The anatomical incisions and exposures utilized (coronal/bicoronal, transconjunctival, subciliary, intraoral vestibular, submandibular, retromandibular, preauricular) and whether the operative plan required staged sequential surgeries.
required_inputs: surgical_approaches (array of enums), staged_procedure (object: is_staged, stage_number, total_planned_stages)
source_grounding: Perry & Holmes Atlas Ch. 19 (p. 805; extended approaches, coronal flap elevation, staged panfacial reconstruction); Fonseca Ch. 12 (pp. 240-244).
scoring_proposal: Approach invasiveness and staging profile: Single local/intraoral approach vs Multiple combined extended approaches (e.g. coronal + transconjunctival + intraoral) + Staging. PENDING SURGEON VALIDATION.
clinical_rationale: Coronal flaps and combined transfacial incisions multiply exposure time, blood loss risk, and require precise dissection planes to protect the facial nerve and supraorbital vessels.
uncertainty_and_limitations: Choice of surgical approach is surgeon-dependent and may vary by institutional preference.
double_counting_safeguard: Scores the exposure and staging, independent of how many fractures were reduced through that exposure.
verification_scope: full text (Atlas Ch. 19) / full text (Fonseca Ch. 12)

definition: Total operative duration in minutes, estimated blood loss (EBL in mL), and transfusion requirements. Analyzed as objective surrogates of physiological stress and operative intensity.
source_grounding: Fonseca Ch. 12 (pp. 236-237; vascular injuries); Perry & Holmes Atlas Ch. 19 (pp. 805-808; physiological impact of prolonged trauma surgery).
scoring_proposal: Continuous parameter reporting with uncertainty bounds: e.g. Duration <120 min, 120-240 min, >240 min; EBL <250 mL, 250-750 mL, >750 mL. PENDING SURGEON VALIDATION.
clinical_rationale: Prolonged surgery (>4-6 hours) and significant blood loss reflect extensive anatomical dissection, difficult reduction, or severe hemorrhage control.
uncertainty_and_limitations: Operative time is confounded by surgical team experience, teaching environment, and anesthetic delays. Never assume unrecorded time is zero.
double_counting_safeguard: Reflects overall case resource utilization and physiological stress, not a duplicate of fracture count.
verification_scope: full text (Fonseca Ch. 12) / full text (Atlas Ch. 19)

criterion_name: Documented Intraoperative Complications and Additional Interventions
definition: Acute adverse events occurring during surgery (severe internal maxillary or ethmoidal hemorrhage, dural tear with CSF leak, retrobulbar hematoma/tension, instrument breakage) and unplanned additional procedures necessitated.
required_inputs: intraoperative_complications (array of enums), unplanned_additional_interventions (array of strings)
source_grounding: Perry & Holmes Atlas Ch. 19 (pp. 805-809; acute orbital/dural emergencies); Fonseca Ch. 12 (pp. 236-241; life-threatening hemorrhage, cribriform plate fracture).
scoring_proposal: Complication event register: Absent/Uneventful vs Acute intraoperative event requiring immediate unplanned intervention. PENDING SURGEON VALIDATION.
clinical_rationale: Intraoperative crises dramatically increase technical complexity, requiring urgent hemostatic packing, dural repair, or emergent lateral canthotomy.
uncertainty_and_limitations: Absence of recorded complications in narrative notes does not prove uneventful surgery if records are incomplete.
double_counting_safeguard: Captures unexpected intraoperative surgical crises; distinct from postoperative late complications (which belong to outcome assessment).
verification_scope: full text (Atlas Ch. 19) / full text (Fonseca Ch. 12)
